login.title: Sign in
login.codeHint: From your authenticator app. Lost it? Enter one of your backup codes instead.

errors.invalid: That did not match. Try again.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.notConfigured: Login is not configured (AUTH_SECRET missing, see README).
errors.deviceLimit: This account is already signed in on 2 devices. Sign out or revoke one in Settings on another device (or run `pnpm user revoke` on the home PC).
errors.notEnrolled: This account has no authenticator yet. Run `pnpm user reset-2fa` on the home PC.
errors.expired: The sign-in took too long. Start over.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.chartLabel: Market value and cost of valued holdings per day
portfolio.breakdownHint: Bars: market value. Right: value / cost.
portfolio.chartAtCost: incl. {amount} at cost (no market price yet)
portfolio.chartEstimatedNote: Values up to {date} partly rely on sales whose lot size was estimated (the source did not report quantities then).
portfolio.lotsUnits: {lots, plural, one {# lot} other {# lots}}, {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}

add.title: Add
add.sourceSearchSoon: Searching SNKRDUNK and other sites comes in a later update.
add.noResults: No match. Use "New item" to create it.
add.costHint: Total paid for all units, including anything you want to count (e.g. shipping).
add.rawGradeHint: S: mint, A: near mint, B: light wear, C: wear, D: damaged.

errors.pickProduct: Pick an item from the search results.
errors.pickKind: Choose what kind of item it is.
errors.pickSet: Pick the set, or enter it manually.

add.setSearchPlaceholder: Search by set name or code
add.noSets: No matching set. Use "Not in the list" below.
add.notInList: Not in the list? Enter it manually
add.orderIdHint: Optional. e.g. SNKRDUNK 取引ID or Mercari transaction ID; used to catch duplicates and imports.
add.existingHint: Already registered? Pick it to add this under the same item:
add.onReleaseUnknown: Acquired on release day (enter a full release date first)
add.costFromRetail: Left blank: the retail price x quantity ({amount}) is used.
add.fromLinks: Bought on Mercari? Paste the links instead
add.fromLink: Adding by hand a purchase whose link could not be imported (saving marks the link as done):

holding.marketData: Market prices, chart and price sources
holding.estimatedCostNote: Pulled from "{name}". That item keeps its cost; this estimate splits it across the {count, plural, one {# pull} other {# pulls}} logged from it by market value. It is not counted in any total.

actions.partialHint: You have {total}. Choosing fewer moves them into a separate entry first.
actions.splitHint: Cost is divided in proportion to the units.
actions.openSealedHint: Once the packs are opened the box counts as consumed; its value lives on in the pulls.
actions.extraFeeHint: Upcharges or return shipping. Added to the cost basis.
actions.feesHint: Platform fee and shipping you paid.
actions.editCostHint: Correct the total paid. Use grading or sell for later changes.
actions.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry and its history. Only for entries registered by mistake; this cannot be undone.

intro.edit: Correct what was recorded. The change is kept in the history.
intro.split: Move some units into their own entry, e.g. before selling or grading only some of them.
intro.grade-submit: The fee is added to the cost basis. The card stays raw until it comes back.
intro.sell: Partial sales split the lot automatically.
intro.condition: Only the fields you change are recorded.
intro.editProduct: Applies to every entry of this item.
intro.cancel-order: For orders you cancelled yourself: shops often send no email for that, so the import cannot tell.

actions.cancelOrderConfirm: The order #{order} ({from}) was cancelled: remove all of its lots. Future imports will skip this order.

pulls.name: Card name
pulls.nameHint: Japanese name as printed (e.g. メガレックウザex) lets prices match automatically. Set, franchise and region come from the box.

events.acquiredSummary: {qty, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} for {cost}

settings.title: Settings
settings.collectorsInfo: Collectors run on your home PC (pnpm collect, daily via cron) and write to the database. They never run on Vercel.
settings.devicesInfo: Each account can be signed in on up to 2 devices. Signing out or revoking frees a slot; a new device needs the password and an authenticator code.
settings.jumps: Median moved more than 50% (last 7 days vs the 30 before):

errors.not_owned: Only items you still own can be changed this way.
errors.invalid_quantity: That quantity is not possible for this entry.
errors.not_sealed: Pulls can only come from a sealed TCG product.
errors.not_packaged: This item has no packaging state.
errors.already_at_grader: This card is already at a grader.
errors.not_at_grader: This card is not at a grader.
errors.has_dependents: Other entries depend on this one (pulls or splits), so it cannot be deleted.
errors.forbidden: Only the person who created this item can change it.
errors.badSourceUrl: That is not a SNKRDUNK product link (https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/…).
errors.duplicate_order: This transaction ID is already registered (each SNKRDUNK / Mercari transaction is one item).
errors.noneGraded: Pick a grade for at least one card
errors.tooManyLinks: Up to 200 links at a time.

sources.title: Price sources
sources.info: Where this item's market prices come from. Prices are collected by the home PC once a day.
sources.waiting: Linked. Trades are collected on the next run.
sources.noneYet: Not linked yet. The next collector run looks for this item (SNKRDUNK and TCGplayer for cards, 駿河屋 for other items), or paste its link below.
sources.missingStable: Not linked to {source} yet: it is this item's main price source. Confirm a suggestion below or paste its link.
sources.pasteUrl: Paste a SNKRDUNK or TCGplayer product link
sources.pasteUrlItem: Paste a 駿河屋, SNKRDUNK or TCGplayer product link
sources.matchesInfo: The collector found possible SNKRDUNK listings for these items. Open one to confirm the right match.
sources.banner: {count, plural, one {# item has} other {# items have}} a price source to confirm
sources.addAnother: Add another listing ({count, plural, =0 {paste a link} one {# suggestion} other {# suggestions}})

search.title: search
search.found: {kept} of the latest {total} sold items kept
search.off: {source} search is off for this item
search.keywordsHint: All of these must be in the title.
search.excludeHint: Titles with any of these words are left out.
search.saved: Saved. The next collect searches again with it.
search.referenceHint: Paste a link to a listing of this exact item. A sold one counts as a price; any listing teaches the search the words, category and photo sellers use. Read on the next collect.

valuation.title: Market value (median)
valuation.noDataHint: No market data for this condition yet. Link a price source, wait for trades, or set a manual price.
valuation.manualActive: A manual price is set and overrides market data.
valuation.manualHint: Per unit, for this condition only. Always wins over market data.

confidenceHint.low: Few or old sales, a store price, or the retail price

valuation.daysWithTrades: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} with trades
valuation.chartLabel: Daily median sale price per source for the selected condition
valuation.estimatedNote: Up to {date}, some trades did not say how many units they covered (e.g. 10 cards in one sale); their lot sizes are estimated from the going price, so those days may be off.
valuation.estimatedSamples: {count} of the {total} sales in this median have an estimated lot size (the source did not report how many units they covered).

box.asReceivedHint: No market data for the box in the state you received it. Set its price here (per box) to value it.
box.manualTitle: Price of the box as received

grades.title: Card grades
grades.intro: Tick cards and set one grade for all of them (e.g. a batch bought as PSA 10). Cards without a grade get no market value.
grades.apply: {count, plural, =0 {Set grade} one {Set grade on # card} other {Set grade on # cards}}
grades.done: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing changed} one {Updated # card} other {Updated # cards}}
grades.banner: {count, plural, one {# card has} other {# cards have}} no grade yet

imports.title: Review import
imports.intro: Imported purchases, one row per transaction. Cards: pick the grade (and the cert number for slabs). Sealed items: shrink or not. Save confirms the rows that are filled in; cards without a grade wait here until you set one or confirm them without.
imports.confirmAll: {count, plural, one {Confirm # card without grade} other {Confirm # cards without grade}}
imports.banner: {count, plural, one {# imported purchase to review} other {# imported purchases to review}}
imports.doneCancelled: {count, plural, one {# cancelled order removed} other {# cancelled orders removed}}

reason.deadline_missed: The seller missed the shipping deadline: if you cancelled this order, tick the box below.
reason.no_delivery: Some purchases of this item have no delivery email: if this was one you cancelled, tick the box below.
reason.date_approx: Date read from the listing (its last update, usually a few days after the purchase): correct it if you know the day.
reason.new_product: New item made from the listing title: check its name and details on its page.
reason.price_far: The price is far from what this item sells for: check the item and the price.
reason.check_product: Claude matched this to an item the title may not support (or to a new one named like an item you have): check which item it is.
reason.ai_unsure: Claude was not sure about part of this row (read from your files): check the details.
reason.maybe_same: Another lot from your files may be the same purchase (e.g. its listing and its transaction page): if so, merge them with “Same purchase as”.

links.title: Add purchases by link
links.intro: For shops that send no receipt email (Mercari): paste the links of things you bought, one per line (Mercari app: 購入した商品 > the item > share > copy link). The home PC reads them on the next collect; collectibles then show up above for review, other things are skipped.
links.label: Purchase links
links.added: {count, plural, one {# link added} other {# links added}}
links.known: {count, plural, one {# already added} other {# already added}}
links.banner: {count, plural, one {# purchase link could not be imported: add it by hand} other {# purchase links could not be imported: add them by hand}}
links.failedIntro: Open each link (you can still see your purchase there) and add the item by hand from its "Add by hand" link; saving marks the link as done. Remove a link with × if you do not need it.
links.pasted: Pasted links ({count}, {pending} waiting for the next collect)

hub.intro: Everything you import: what needs you, ways to import, and what each import did.
hub.emailIntro: Export the shop's order emails with Google Takeout, then run this on the home PC. Imported items show up here to review.
hub.lots: {count, plural, one {# lot from this import} other {# lots from this import}}
hub.linksRead: {count, plural, one {# link read} other {# links read}}

count.matched: {count, plural, one {# matched an entry} other {# matched entries}}
count.duplicate: {count, plural, one {# already registered} other {# already registered}}
count.flagged: {count, plural, one {# flagged for review} other {# flagged for review}}
count.left: {count, plural, one {# left for next time} other {# left for next time}}

hub.aiIntro: Screenshots of order lists or order pages, PDFs, CSV or copied text from any shop: put them in one folder and run this on the home PC. Haiku reads them, Sonnet reads again what looks off, and everything lands here to review.

imports.removeLot: Remove this lot (not one of my purchases)
imports.sameAsHint: This lot is merged into the one chosen: that one stays, taking this one's order ID, price or date where it has none.

merge.hint: Is this the same item as one already registered? Pick it to merge this one into it:
merge.title: Merge duplicate
merge.intro: Everything recorded under the duplicate (lots, prices, listings) moves to the existing item, and the duplicate is deleted.
merge.confirm: Move {lots, plural, one {# lot} other {# lots}} (and its sales data and listings) to "{name}" and delete the duplicate.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.intro: Fixes the data review proposes after a collect: a model looked at sales and searches the checks flagged. Nothing changes until you accept. Filled by `pnpm review` (or `pnpm collect --review`) on the home PC.
suggestions.banner: {count, plural, one {# suggestion to check} other {# suggestions to check}}
suggestions.unsure: The models were not sure: check the listing.
suggestions.word: Make the {source} search skip listings with “{word}”. Its sales are fetched again on the next collect.
suggestions.openProductPage: Open the product on {source} (it shows no single trade)
suggestions.wordListings: {kept, plural, =0 {Listings with the word (none counted in the value now):} one {Listings with the word (# counted in the value now, removed on accept):} other {Listings with the word (# counted in the value now, removed on accept):}}
suggestions.notePlaceholder: Note for the review (optional): why, or what it should know next time
suggestions.notesIntro: Given to the models on every later review; they follow them over their own judgment. Delete one when it no longer applies.

compare.title: Japan vs US
compare.info: Same condition on both sides ({bucket}). US prices are shown for comparison only and never count in the value.
compare.graded: TCGplayer only prices ungraded cards, so your graded cards are compared at this condition.

coverage.title: Price sources to link
coverage.intro: Items without their stable price source. The home PC looks for matches on each collect; confirm one on the item page or paste a link.
coverage.banner: {count, plural, one {# item has} other {# items have}} no stable price source linked

snkrdunk.title: Cards and sealed product not linked to SNKRDUNK ({count})
snkrdunk.intro: SNKRDUNK is the stable source for cards, boxes, decks and special sets; Mercari searches are a plus.

surugaya.title: Items not linked to 駿河屋 ({count})
surugaya.intro: Games, consoles, supplies and other items that cost more than {amount}: a 駿河屋 page gives store and buy-back prices.

coverage.suggestions: {count, plural, one {# suggestion to confirm} other {# suggestions to confirm}}
coverage.noSuggestion: No match found yet: paste a link
coverage.none: Every item has its price source linked.
